I, Gayantha Karunatilleke, Minister of Lands and ParliamentaryReforms, hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of theLand Acquisition Act, that the land described below is needed for apublic purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

The Allotments of land depicted in the Advance Tracing No.KU/IBB/2017/085 dated of 22.03.2017 prepared by the surveyorGeneral, situated in the Villages of Kumbalanga, Koongahagedaraand Grama Niladhari Divisions of No. 523, Kumbalanga, No. 524,Nembilikumbura in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Ibbagamuwaof Kurunegala District in North Western Province and described inbelow names and extents as follows.
